title: Find the slow lifecycle command on Windows and fix it or its bound
goal: The Windows lifecycle test passes without reruns
acceptance: The slow command and its bound are named in the record
A committed test fails first if the cause is in code; otherwise the bound comes from measured Windows timings
The Windows job passes without reruns
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18: read the CI log, time the commands, fix or bound, one test. Not a measurement.
